intent: Teach arrival-check order, departure delay units, fog cause, conditional possible cancellation, hoped-for study abroad, postcard origins, suggested foreign-language greeting and literal international-event evidence.
picturePurpose: Five proposed coded comparison models, one order and two exact evidence tasks. No country, actual timetable or weather measurement invented.

workshop.title: 看信息牌，判断行程有没有改变
workshop.instruction: 改单位、切条件、排先后；分清延误、可能取消、希望和已经发生。

items.hint: arrival是arrive的名词形式；again要求再核对，原句没有给几点到达。
items.material: Check the arrival time again before leaving home.

transfer.stem: 换成野餐、十分钟和两年工作，哪组保留全部信息？
transfer.passage:
三条新信息
信息牌显示延误十分钟。如果下雨，我们可能取消野餐。她希望出国工作两年。
词语提示：noticeboard 信息牌；picnic 野餐；work 工作。
